intro.fr: Pokémon Black and White se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Pokémon Black and White can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub BlastSlimey/PokemonBWAP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Pokémon Black and White.
text.en: The GitHub repository BlastSlimey/PokemonBWAP, home of the Pokémon Black and White APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.4.2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (55 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.4.2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (55 versions released).

text.fr: Pokémon Black and White figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Pokémon Black and White is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
